notes.title: Fix typos
notes.content: Fixed some typos in the Japanese scripts.

notes.title: Now "Dawn of Griseo" Supports English!
notes.content:
For more people to enjoy "Dawn of Griseo", the following updates have been made.

[h3]English Support[/h3]
All scripts in the game are translated to English!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307042/b4f33d09c0337dff63815f1651ecca09ba9b6a8d.png[/img]

When the game is launched for the first time (after this update), you are asked which language you prefer.
Also you can change the language by the button at the bottom right of the title screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307042/92389b011b2557e40eb929463c781fd26ad7ffb4.png[/img]

[h3]Different Name Color for Each Main Character[/h3]
Character names in the dialogue windows are now colored differently for each character.
You can see who is talking more clearly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307042/2881a60be600215055322a04564a6bc1b116cfc5.png[/img]

[h3]Gallary Mode[/h3]
A Gallary mode that allows you to browse CGs used in the game has been added.
It will be available after you clear the game (after you get two endings).
